# Copilot instructions

This repository's agent guidance is maintained agent-generically in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read it first, then the
skills it points to. Where this file and `AGENTS.md` disagree, `AGENTS.md`
wins.

The earlier instructions here described only the Python DAK extraction
workflow. They were retired on 2026-10-23, together with the old
`multifile.xml` agent notes, and are kept in the platform's archive rather
than deleted.
